output.text: Welcome, explorer, to the Chalk Maze. Step in with calm focus. Follow white chalk lines—never rush. At a fork, pause and check all paths. A left curve means take it. A dead end? Retrace. The maze shifts—what opens may close. Watch for symbols: a circle means go forward; a square means turn. Stay aware. You are not lost—you are finding your way. Keep moving, one step at a time. The exit waits for you.

parsed.text: Welcome, explorer, to the Chalk Maze. Step inside with calm focus. Each path is drawn in white chalk—follow the lines, but never rush. When you reach a fork, pause and check all three directions. If a path curves left, take it. If it ends in a dead end, retrace your steps. Trust your instincts, but stay patient. The maze shifts subtly—what was open may close. Watch for chalk symbols: a circle means go forward; a square means turn. Stay aware. You are not lost—you are finding your way. Keep moving, one step at a time. The exit waits for you.
